text.en:
Land Titles (Strata) Act
(Chapter 158, Sections 126A(5))
Land Titles (Strata) (Designated Lands) (Consolidation) Notification
N 3
REVISED EDITION 1998
(15th June 1998)

THE SCHEDULE
1. All that part of Pine Grove housing estate comprised in Lot numbers 4766 and 4003 in Mukim 4 on which Apartment Blocks 1A to 1H, 1J to 1N and 1P are erected.
2. All that part of Gillman Heights housing estate comprised in Lot number 1478 in Mukim 1 on which Apartment Blocks 1A to 1H, 1J and 1K are erected.
[S 351/95 - 11.8.95]
3. All that part of Jurong East housing estate comprised in Lot number 5161 in Mukim 5 and on which Apartment Blocks 117 to 124 are erected.
4. All that part of Hougang South housing estate comprised in Lot numbers 4587 to 4594 in Mukim 22 and on which Apartment Blocks 146 to 153 are erected.
5. All that part of Lakeview housing estate comprised in Lot number 1911 of Mukim 15 and on which Apartment Blocks 97A to 97C are erected.
6. All that part of Farrer Court housing estate comprised in Lot numbers 2195 and 2196 of Mukim 2 and on which Apartment Blocks 151A to 151H are erected.
[S 149/96 - 5.4.96]
7. All that part of Laguna Park housing estate comprised in Lot number 4458 in Mukim 27 and on which Apartment Blocks 5000A to 5000G are erected.
8. All that part of Shunfu Road housing estate comprised in Lot number 10675 in Mukim 18 and on which Apartment Blocks 314 to 319 are erected.
[S 298/96 -- 5.7.96]
9. All that part of Bedok Reservoir housing estate comprised in Lot numbers 3020 to 3025 and 3124 to 3130 in Mukim 28 on which Apartment Blocks 726 to 738 are erected.
10. All that part of Chancery Court housing estate comprised in Lot number 661 in Town Subdivision 28 on which Apartment Blocks 36A to 36H are erected.
[S 445/96 4.10.96]
11. All that part of Amberville housing estate comprised in Lot number 3975 in Mukim 25 and on which Apartment Blocks 50A, 50B and 50D are erected.
12. All that part of Tampines housing estate comprised in Lot number 4196 in Mukim 28 and on which Apartment Blocks 118 to 123 and 128 to 135 are erected.
[S 273/97 - 6.6.97]
13. All that part of Serangoon North housing estate comprised in Lot number 10733 in Mukim 18 and on which Apartment Blocks 128 to 134 are erected.
14. All that part of Eunosville housing estate comprised in Lot number 4132 in Mukim 23 and on which Apartment Blocks 822, 824, 826, 828, 830, 832, 834, 836, 838 and 840 are erected.
[S 499/97 - 19.11.97]
